bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and mechanical textures. A distorted kick drum with a long, saturated sub-tail drives the rhythm at 130 BPM in the key of C minor. A metallic, percussive synth sequence repeats a syncopated sixteenth-note pattern. High-frequency white noise bursts and bit-crushed industrial hits occur on the off-beats. A resonant low-pass filter sweep modulates a gritty sawtooth bassline. The percussion features a sharp, metallic closed hi-hat on every eighth note and a layered clap with heavy reverb on the second and fourth beats. A dark, atmospheric drone pad sits in the background with a slow LFO modulating the cutoff frequency. Periodic glitch effects and tape-stop stutters interrupt the main loop.

[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum with sub-tail, metallic synth sequence]
[bit-crushed industrial hits]

[Main Section]
[syncopated sixteenth-note synth pattern, closed hi-hats]
[resonant low-pass filter sweep on sawtooth bass]
[layered clap with heavy reverb on beats 2 and 4]
[atmospheric drone pad with LFO modulation]

[Outro]
[glitch effects and tape-stop stutter]
[kick drum fades out, white noise bursts]

drums.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and power chords. A prominent bass guitar follows the guitar riffs with a thick, overdriven tone. The drum kit features a heavy snare, double-kick pedal patterns, and frequent crash cymbal accents. A high-pitched male vocal performs with a gritty, aggressive delivery and occasional melodic flourishes. The track is in the key of E minor at 140 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement features a breakdown with a syncopated guitar and drum pattern before returning to a driving tempo. Lead guitar sections include fast alternate picking and wah-pedal filtered solos.
